subject: scripts/mac/sg-brain-link.sh carries a personal absolute path in the tree
body: The independent review of #1907 found that scripts/mac/sg-brain-link.sh on mainline holds a /Users/<name>/ absolute path (git grep counts 2 lines). The owner's rule keeps personal paths out of GitHub. It is your script: replace the literal with $HOME or a config lookup when convenient. Also noted, older code: lane-tick.sh puts the absolute $TICK_WT path and a ~/Library/Logs path into the heartbeat RESULT (lines ~207-221, ~310); #1907's fix round scrubs those on the #1890 branch.
